metadata.summary: Bridge mod between SkyrimNet (LLM) and SexLab Framework.
metadata.compile: Use the VS Code / Cursor task "compile: pyro" (pyro against skyrimse.ppj, game path C:\Skyrim\dev\skyrim). Do not invent alternate one-off compile commands.
metadata.dependencies: SexLabFramework, JContainers, StorageUtil, SKSE, SkyrimNet API, PO3_SKSEFunctions, UIExtensions, SkyMessage. SkyrimNet_DOM is optional (../SkyrimNet_DOM/Scripts/Source).

architecture.flow: Creator (pooled) -> StartScene -> Manager.CreateSceneByCreator -> Scene.Setup(creator) -> caller MUST creator.Release().
architecture.detail: manager.CreateCreator() returns the first inactive slot from a fixed creators[] pool and marks it ACTIVE; returns None when exhausted. Scene.Setup copies all values out of the creator, so every caller must Release() afterwards to free the slot.
Manager hooks SexLab thread events and routes to Scene handlers. SkyrimNet consumes scene state as JSON via Scene.GetDescription / GetObj and the decorators in SkyrimNet_SexLab_Decorators.psc.
DOM is optional: main.handler_dom is either the Interface stub (safe no-op/passthrough on the Main quest) or the real SkyrimNet_SexLab_Handler_DOM.esp. Main.Setup guarantees handler_dom is non-None.
SeparateOrgasms for Dom slaves: Manager intentionally skips; external SkyrimNet_DOM OnOrgasm -> DOMSlave_Orgasmed -> Manager.OrgasmCustom (which appends " is orgasming.").
External-consumer JSON keys are underscore-prefixed (e.g. _actors, _activity, _options); prompts must read the exact underscored key.

locked_decisions.note: Design decisions confirmed by the user; treat as settled.
locked_decisions.decision: Creator.Release() on cancel or once the Scene is created; full pool-slot reset.
Narration param name is optional_is_dropped everywhere; fallback optional_is_dropped=True.
RegisterEvent is silent on blank message and on duplicates (silent drop only).
Shared NarrationCoolOffAllows(source, target); CheckDuplicate calls ContinueActivity when cool-off allows.
Both source and target None: silent drop; no ContinueActivity from CheckDuplicate.
Player fallback StorageUtil key used when source is None.
First StageStart: GetIntentMessage(INTENT_STAGE_START) + append stage desc if non-empty; empty desc -> ContinueActivity(..., True). Non-first or unchanged desc -> ContinueActivity(True).
Dom Combined narration: silent unless orgasm_expected==1; LLM reminder only when a slave did not orgasm.
Menu locks actors via LockAllActorLock (mirrors Action_Start); Release on lock failure.
SkyrimNet_DOM optional: Interface stub + real Handler_DOM must both work.

how_to_resume.step: Read review-guide.xml (persona, output rules, do-not-report facts) and this checkpoint.
For a new review pass: regenerate review-execution-plan.xml with findings ordered High->Medium->Low, each with problem, suggested fix, filename, and 1-based line number (include commented lines).
Apply fixes, compile via the "compile: pyro" task, write reviews/<YYYY-MM-DD-NN>.review.md, then add a <pass> entry here and update <updated> and <current_status>.
Respect <constraints> and <locked_decisions>; do not re-report items listed there.
